He founded its new fort and capital the following year, making the surrounding country part of a smaller surviving Rohilla state.
simp_chinese: 沙哈巴德位于兰普尔附近的罗希尔坎德平原，这一地区长期与罗希拉阿富汗人相联系。城中有一座兰普尔纳瓦布的旧宫殿。1774年，罗希拉人败于阿瓦德和东印度公司后，法伊祖拉汗在英国保护下建立兰普尔邦国。次年，他建立新的堡垒和都城，使周围地区成为这一保留下来的较小罗希拉国家的一部分。

english:
Shaharah stands in the high mountains of northern Yemen, where steep slopes and deep ravines create a strongly defended landscape. Terraced cultivation made use of limited ground, while settlements depended on careful management of rainwater and other local supplies. Paths and bridges linked places separated by difficult terrain, giving control of access a practical importance. Stone buildings and compact settlement reflected the need to live within a demanding mountain environment.

Shaharah was an important stronghold during the Yemeni–Ottoman conflicts of the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries. Ottoman forces captured it in 1587 after repeated attempts; it later served as the capital of the Zaydi imam al-Mansur al-Qasim, who died there in 1620. The town was also a centre of learning, home to jurists, scholars and poets. Its mountain setting shaped both its defensibility and the routes connecting it to other districts.
simp_chinese:
沙哈拉位于也门北部高山，陡坡和深谷形成防守能力很强的景观。梯田利用有限土地，聚落依靠谨慎管理雨水及其他地方供应。小路和桥梁连接被险峻地形分隔的地点，使控制出入具有实际价值。石造房屋与紧凑聚居，体现居民适应艰难山地环境的需要。

十六至十七世纪也门与奥斯曼的冲突中，沙哈拉是重要山地据点。奥斯曼军队多次尝试后，于1587年攻取此地；后来它成为宰德派伊玛目曼苏尔·卡西姆的都城，后者于1620年在此去世。城镇也是学术中心，孕育了法学家、学者和诗人。山地环境既影响防御，也影响连接其他地区的道路。

english: Shaharpara stands beside the Ratna River in the wetland country west of Sylhet. Local tradition credits Shah Kamal Quhafa and his companions with founding the settlement in the early fourteenth century. The village grew on raised ground among the waters, and the tombs associated with Shah Kamal and his family became places of remembrance. His followers and descendants helped establish Shaharpara as a centre of Muslim religious life in the surrounding countryside.
simp_chinese: 沙哈尔帕拉位于锡尔赫特以西的湿地地区，靠近拉特纳河。地方传统认为沙阿·卡迈勒·库哈法及其同伴于十四世纪初创建了这一聚落。村庄在水域间的高地上成长，与沙阿·卡迈勒及其家人相关的墓地成为纪念之所。他的追随者和后裔使沙哈尔帕拉成为周边乡村穆斯林宗教生活的一个中心。

english: Shahbazpur is the island country at the mouth of the Meghna, between the great channels leading into the Bay of Bengal. The land is formed from river-borne silt and is continually reshaped by currents, erosion and new deposits. James Rennell’s eighteenth-century map records the island as South Shahbazpur. The shifting waterways around it could consume old land even as new islands and banks emerged farther out in the estuary.
simp_chinese: 沙巴兹布尔是梅格纳河口的岛屿地带，位于通往孟加拉湾的宽阔水道之间。土地由河流带来的泥沙形成，水流、侵蚀与新的沉积不断改变其形状。詹姆斯·伦内尔的十八世纪地图将这里记为南沙巴兹布尔。变化中的水道可能吞没旧土地，同时在河口更远处形成新的岛屿和沙洲。

english:
Shahdad, historically called Khabis, stands on the western edge of the Lut Desert. Its oasis lies near a remarkable expanse of wind-carved ridges, or kaluts, beyond which the desert becomes exceptionally dry. The neighbourhood was inhabited in the third millennium BCE, when craftspeople worked copper and fashioned vessels and ornaments. Graves and workshops preserve traces of this early centre at the desert's edge.

In medieval times Khabis was a caravan station at the meeting of routes between Central Asia, the Persian Gulf and Mesopotamia. Travellers crossing the Iranian plateau could stop at the oasis before facing the arid country beyond. The older Bronze Age settlement and the later caravan town belong to different chapters of a long history of habitation around the margins of the Lut, where the interior offered little water or shelter.
simp_chinese:
沙达德旧称哈比斯，位于卢特沙漠西缘。绿洲附近是一片奇特的风蚀土脊，称为卡卢特；再往内陆，沙漠便极为干旱。公元前三千纪，这一带已有人居住，工匠加工铜，制作器皿和装饰品。墓葬与作坊留下了沙漠边缘这一早期中心的痕迹。

中世纪时，哈比斯是商队驿站，位于连接中亚、波斯湾和美索不达米亚的道路交会处。穿越伊朗高原的旅人可在绿洲歇脚，再进入前方的干旱地带。较早的青铜时代聚落与后来的商队城镇，属于卢特边缘长期有人居住的不同历史篇章；沙漠内部则鲜有水源与庇护之所。

english: Shahe lies where the Taihang Mountains descend toward the plain of southern Hebei. West of the town, Guangyang Mountain rises above the surrounding valleys, its slopes holding Buddhist rock-cut caves. Mountain streams emerge from these uplands and flow eastward across the plain. The contrast between the steep western hills and the lower country around the settlement gives Shahe its distinctive setting.
simp_chinese: 沙河位于太行山向河北南部平原下降的地带。城西广阳山高出周围谷地，山坡上留有佛教石窟。山间溪水从高地流出，向东穿过平原。西侧陡峭的山岭与聚落附近的低地形成鲜明对照。

english: Shahe lies on the Nanliu River southwest of Bobai. The river runs through a region of low hills and cultivated land before continuing south toward the sea. A local patrol office governed the district in the Qing, when the surrounding area was known as Daqi. Shahe was also one of the market places recorded in a Daoguang-era gazetteer of Bobai, where people from the neighboring countryside could meet to exchange goods.
simp_chinese: 沙河位于博白西南的南流江畔。江水穿过低丘与耕地，继续向南流向大海。清代这里设有沙河巡检司，周围一带称大旗堡。道光年间的《博白县志》也记载了沙河圩，附近乡民在此聚集交换货物。

english:
Shahjadpur is associated with the shrine of the Muslim holy man Makhdum Shah. Beside his burial place stands an old brick mosque supported by dark stone columns. Its architectural form belongs to the period before Mughal rule in Bengal, although the building bears no inscription establishing its date. The mosque and shrine remain linked in local tradition to the holy man and his followers.

One account tells that Makhdum Shah came to Bengal with his sister, nephews and a company of dervishes. After a struggle with a local ruler, he was killed, and his nephew Shah Nur buried him near the mosque. The narrative belongs to the traditions surrounding the spread of Islam in the region; the mosque itself provides a tangible monument to the religious settlement that grew at Shahjadpur.
simp_chinese:
沙贾德布尔与穆斯林圣人马克杜姆沙阿的陵寝相联系。墓地旁有一座古老砖造清真寺，由深色石柱支撑。建筑形式属于孟加拉莫卧儿统治之前的时代，但寺内没有可确定建造日期的铭文。在地方传统中，清真寺和陵寝都与这位圣人及其追随者相连。

一个故事讲述马克杜姆沙阿与姐妹、外甥和一群托钵僧来到孟加拉。他与当地统治者发生冲突并被杀，外甥沙阿·努尔将他葬在清真寺附近。这一传说属于当地伊斯兰教传播的记忆，而清真寺本身则是沙贾德布尔宗教聚落留下的实体见证。

sources.title: 1904 Proceedings of Asiatic Society of Bengal.pdf

english: Shahjahanpur was founded in the reign of the Mughal emperor Shah Jahan by the brothers Diler Khan and Bahadur Khan. Their father Darya Khan had come from Kandahar and served in Jahangir's army. In 1647 Shah Jahan rewarded Diler Khan with seventeen villages and permission to build a fort after the suppression of the Katehriya Rajputs. Bahadur Khan brought Afghan settlers to the new town, which grew into a centre of the surrounding country.
simp_chinese: 沙贾汉布尔由迪莱尔汗与巴哈杜尔汗兄弟在莫卧儿皇帝沙贾汗统治时期建立。他们的父亲达里亚汗来自坎大哈，曾在贾汉吉尔军中服役。1647年，镇压卡泰里亚拉杰普特人后，沙贾汗赏赐迪莱尔汗十七个村庄，并准许他筑堡。巴哈杜尔汗将阿富汗移民带到新城，城镇逐渐成为周围地区的中心。

english: Shahpur lies beside the Jhelum River in the Punjab. It takes its name from the shrine of Syed Shams Shah Shirazi, a scholar and holy man who came here in 1606. He married Malika Sultana, holder of the Khushab jagir, and attracted many followers among the people of the surrounding country. His shrine gave the settlement a lasting religious association.
simp_chinese: 沙赫普尔坐落在旁遮普的杰赫勒姆河畔，得名于赛义德·沙姆斯沙·设拉子的圣祠。这位学者和圣人于1606年来到此地，迎娶了胡沙卜采邑的持有人马利卡·苏丹娜，并在附近居民中吸引了许多追随者。他的圣祠使这处聚落与宗教传统有了长久的联系。

english: Shahr-e Babak lies on the dry plateau between the cities of Fars and Kerman. Its name means the city of Babak, father of Ardashir, the founder of the Sasanian dynasty; tradition associates its foundation with that ancient royal family. The old settlement and surrounding villages occupy a landscape of mountains and desert plains. Among the district's older buildings are mosques and religious sites, while roads connect the inland town with the oases and cities of southeastern Iran.
simp_chinese: 沙赫尔巴巴克位于法尔斯诸城与克尔曼之间的干旱高原。地名意为“巴巴克之城”，巴巴克是萨珊王朝创立者阿尔达希尔之父；传统将城镇的建立与这一古老王室相联系。老聚落和周围村庄坐落在山地与荒漠平原之间。当地古建筑包括清真寺和宗教场所，道路则将内陆城镇与伊朗东南部的绿洲和城市连接起来。

english: Shahr Meyan lies west of Eqlid in the uplands of northern Fars, on a route through the valleys towards Khosrow Shirin and Abadeh. The settlement belongs to a country of small plains enclosed by the Zagros ranges. Shul communities inhabit villages along these mountain roads, where fields and pasture occupy the more level ground. The highland climate is cooler than the southern plains, and springs and seasonal streams support cultivation between the ridges.
simp_chinese: 沙赫尔梅扬位于法尔斯北部高地、埃格利德以西，谷间道路通往霍斯罗希林和阿巴德。聚落所在的地区由扎格罗斯山脉环绕的小平原组成。舒尔社群居住在沿山路的村庄中，较平坦的地面有田地与牧场。高地气候比南方平原凉爽，泉水和季节性溪流滋养山岭间的耕地。

english: Shahr Sabz lies near Dasht-e Naomid, an arid plain in western Afghanistan. East of the desert runs the Adraskan River, called the Harut farther south. Near Anar Dara it receives the waters of the Anar Dara River before continuing toward the Hamun wetlands of Sistan. Floods can spread across parts of the plain, leaving shallow depressions among the dry ground.
simp_chinese: 青沙赫尔靠近阿富汗西部的干旱平原纳奥米德荒漠。荒漠以东流淌着阿德拉斯坎河，向南又称哈鲁特河；它在阿纳尔达拉附近接纳同名河流，继续流向锡斯坦的哈蒙湿地。洪水有时漫过平原部分地带，干地间散布着浅洼。

english: Shahrakht lies in the Zirkuh country east of Qaen, close to the mountains that give the district its name. Medieval geographers counted Shirakhs among the towns of these foothills. North of the settlement stands the fortress of Hasan Baykhan, attributed to the Seljuk period. The region's castles and cultivated villages occupy a dry borderland between the mountains and the plains of eastern Khorasan.
simp_chinese: 沙赫拉赫特位于加延以东的济尔库赫地区，靠近为当地得名的山脉。中世纪地理学家将希拉赫斯列为山麓城镇之一。聚落以北的哈桑·拜汗堡被认为属于塞尔柱时期。堡垒与耕作村庄分布在山岭和呼罗珊东部平原之间干燥的边地。

english: Shahrestan-e Sofla lies in the mountainous Rudbar-e Shahrestan district, west of Alamut. The steep valleys of this part of the Alborz offered strong positions for fortresses. Nearby Lambsar stood above a deep gorge and was one of the strongholds held by the Nizari Ismailis, whose mountain castles resisted their enemies until the Mongol campaigns of the thirteenth century.
simp_chinese: 下沙赫雷斯坦位于阿拉穆特以西的鲁德巴尔沙赫雷斯坦山区。厄尔布尔士山脉这一部分的陡峭谷地为堡垒提供了险要的地势。附近的兰布萨尔城堡高踞深谷之上，是尼扎里派伊斯玛仪派据守的要塞之一；他们的山地城堡抵御敌人，直到十三世纪蒙古人发动征伐。

english: Shajwa stands in the Wadi al-Hamd country northwest of Medina, among settlements distributed along the valley toward Yanbu. The wadi gathers runoff from a broad expanse of the Hijaz before making its way to the Red Sea. In this dry landscape, the valley floor offers space for cultivation and pasture; Shajwa is associated with the Banu Muhammad branch of the Harb confederation.
simp_chinese: 沙杰瓦位于麦地那西北的哈姆德谷地，附近聚落沿山谷向延布方向分布。哈姆德谷汇集汉志广大地区的径流，最终通向红海。在这片干旱土地上，谷地为耕作和放牧提供了空间；沙杰瓦与哈布部族联盟中的巴努穆罕默德支系有关。

english: The Shaké are among the peoples of the upper Ogooué country, where forest and river valleys shaped a history of movement and settlement. Their traditions recall the village of Kandjamabika on the upper Offoué, formed by Shaké and Simba lineages and joined by a Kota lineage. Later the village moved downstream. The region between Lastoursville and Okondja was home to several communities with related histories.
simp_chinese: 沙凯人是奥果韦河上游地区的族群之一，森林与河谷塑造了这里的迁徙和定居历史。传统记得奥富埃河上游的坎贾马比卡村：沙凯和辛巴人的支系在此聚居，后来又有科托人支系加入。村落此后迁往下游。拉斯图尔维尔与奥孔贾之间的地区居住着数个历史相互关联的社群。

english:
Shakhty lies on the Grushevka, among the coal-bearing southeastern ridges of the Donets country. The growth of settlements here was tied to the Don Cossacks and to the discovery that the black stone beneath their land could be used as fuel. Several Cossack farmsteads were founded on the site in 1805, among them Popovka and Vlasovka, named after the Cossack officers who established them.

In 1809, Popov opened a shaft worked by his serfs; its coal helped heat buildings and Cossack barracks at Novocherkassk. Other small mines followed, including one opened by the Cossack Semyon Koshkin in 1817, where a horse-powered winch raised the coal. The Grushevsky mine, established in 1836, gave the district a further focus for the extraction that would later shape the town.
simp_chinese:
沙赫特位于格鲁舍夫卡河畔，处于顿涅茨地区东南部蕴藏煤炭的丘陵间。此地聚落的发展与顿河哥萨克人密切相关，也与人们发现地下黑色石块可以用作燃料有关。1805年，几座哥萨克庄户在此建立，其中包括以创建者的姓氏命名的波波夫卡和弗拉索夫卡。

1809年，波波夫开凿了一座由其农奴开采的矿井，所产煤炭用来为新切尔卡斯克的建筑和哥萨克营房供暖。此后又出现其他小矿井，其中一座由哥萨克人谢苗·科什金于1817年开凿，使用马力绞盘提升煤炭。1836年建立的格鲁舍夫斯基矿场进一步推动了当地采矿业的发展。

english:
Shaki lies in a wooded valley on the southern slopes of the Greater Caucasus. For centuries its people raised silkworms and traded cocoons and raw silk, while craftsmen produced textiles, carpets and metalwork. Mulberry trees in household gardens fed the worms, and airy upper rooms beneath steep roofs provided space for their cultivation. The town's position on routes between Asia and Europe brought merchants and their wares to its markets.

Shaki was contested by Safavid and Ottoman rulers before becoming the center of a khanate in 1743. In 1772 a destructive mud flood swept away the earlier town; its inhabitants rebuilt on higher ground at Nukha, east of the old site. The new town grew around gardens, streams and channels, whose waters supplied houses and irrigated productive plots, with caravanserais, baths, mosques and shops serving the silk trade. The khan's fortified residence overlooked this busy settlement.

The palace built under Mammad Hasan Khan in 1797 expressed the wealth of the khanate in painted interiors and intricate #italic shabaka#! windows of colored glass and wood. Merchants' houses likewise combined decorated rooms with productive gardens and their mulberry trees. In the early nineteenth century Russian authority replaced the khans, but the town's streets and buildings retained the imprint of the silk economy that had shaped them.
simp_chinese:
沙基位于大高加索南坡一处林木茂盛的山谷。数世纪以来，居民饲养蚕虫、贩运蚕茧与生丝，工匠制作织物、地毯和金属器物。住宅花园里的桑树为蚕提供食物，陡屋顶下通风的上层房间则供养蚕使用。城镇坐落在连接亚洲与欧洲的道路上，商人及货物汇集于此。

萨法维与奥斯曼统治者曾争夺沙基；1743年，它成为一个汗国的中心。1772年的泥石洪流摧毁旧城，居民在旧址以东较高的努哈重建。新城围绕花园、溪流与水渠发展，水渠供应住宅并灌溉种植地，商队客栈、浴场、清真寺和店铺服务于丝绸贸易。汗的设防宅邸俯瞰着繁忙的聚落。

马马德·哈桑汗于1797年修建的宫殿以彩绘内饰和精巧的彩色玻璃木格窗体现汗国的财富。商人宅邸同样将装饰华丽的房间与种有桑树的生产性花园结合起来。十九世纪初，俄国权力取代了诸汗，但城镇街道和建筑仍保留着丝绸经济塑造的印记。

english: Shakka lies southeast of the Marrah Mountains, in the southern reaches of the old Darfur sultanate. Its position placed it among the routes between Darfur and the lands of Bahr al-Ghazal. Merchants known as jellabas traded in this region, where goods and people moved northward from the southern hinterland. Shakka's place in this network reflected the wider reach of Darfur's political and commercial connections beyond its central highlands.
simp_chinese: 沙卡位于马拉山脉东南方，处在旧达尔富尔苏丹国的南部边缘。这里位于达尔富尔与加扎勒河地区之间的交通线上。被称为杰拉巴的商人在这一带活动，货物与人口从南方腹地向北流动。沙卡在网络中的地位，反映了达尔富尔的政治与商业联系延伸到中央高地之外。

english: Shalakusha lies on the Mosha, a tributary of the Onega in the wooded country north of Kargopol. The river valley was part of a network of waterways and portages through which settlers reached the Onega basin. A parish bearing the name Shalakusha existed here; in 1797 it became part of the Ust-Mosha district of Kargopol. Its villages belonged to a landscape of riverbanks and forest clearings.
simp_chinese: 沙拉库沙位于莫沙河畔，地处卡尔戈波尔以北的林区；莫沙河是奥涅加河的支流。河谷属于通往奥涅加流域的水路与拖船路网络，移民曾沿这些道路来到此地。这里设有以沙拉库沙为名的教区；1797年，该教区划入卡尔戈波尔的乌斯季莫沙乡。教区村庄散布在河岸和森林开垦地之间。

english: Shalatenan, later Chalatenango, lies in the hills north of the Lempa River. It was an indigenous town in the colonial province of San Salvador. In 1770 its parish included Arcatao, Concepción Quezaltepeque and other communities, as well as numerous estates and villages. A fair established in 1801 encouraged trade in indigo, then an important product of the district.
simp_chinese: 沙拉特南后来称为查拉特南戈，位于伦帕河以北的丘陵中。它曾是殖民时期圣萨尔瓦多省的一处原住民城镇。1770年，其教区包括阿尔卡陶、康塞普西翁·克萨尔特佩克等社区，以及众多庄园和村落。1801年建立的集市促进了靛蓝贸易，靛蓝当时是该地区的重要产品。

english: Shalkar is a broad, brackish lake in the northern Caspian lowland, east of the Ural River. Its waters lie in a natural hollow fed by branches of the Solyanka, amid saline ground and muddy shallows. In years of abundant water, the lake can drain toward the Ural basin; at other times the outlet is mostly dry. The expanse of water stands out among the open pastures of the surrounding steppe and provides habitat for waterbirds.
simp_chinese: 沙尔卡尔是里海低地北部的一座宽阔咸水湖，位于乌拉尔河以东。湖水汇集在天然洼地中，由索良卡河的支流补给，周围分布盐碱地和泥泞浅滩。水量充沛的年份，湖水可流向乌拉尔河流域；其他时候，出水河道大多干涸。这片水域在周围开阔草原牧场中十分醒目，也为水鸟提供栖息地。

english: Shalkar-Yega-Kara is a shallow steppe lake near the border between the southern Urals and Kazakhstan. Its principal inflow is the Buruktal, which reaches the basin in spring. In many years the stream fails to reach the lake and the water disappears entirely, leaving the shape of the basin exposed. The lake is a striking example of the great seasonal changes in water across this dry interior.
simp_chinese: 沙尔卡尔－叶加卡拉是南乌拉尔与哈萨克斯坦交界附近的一座浅草原湖。主要来水为布鲁克塔尔河，春季流入湖盆；许多年里河水无法抵达湖泊，湖水会完全消失，露出湖盆的轮廓。这座湖鲜明体现了干旱内陆水域巨大的季节变化。

english: Shalkarteniz is a broad salt basin at the southern end of the Turgay depression, northeast of the Aral Sea. In spring, meltwater from the Turgay and Irgiz rivers spreads into the low ground and forms a shallow, bitterly saline lake. As the water withdraws, salt flats and smaller pools remain. The surrounding steppe is cut by dry channels and dotted with enclosed hollows.
simp_chinese: 沙尔卡滕尼兹是托尔盖洼地南端一片广阔的盐碱盆地，位于咸海东北方。春季，托尔盖河和伊尔吉兹河的融雪水漫入低地，形成浅而苦咸的湖泊。水退之后，留下盐滩和较小的水池。周围草原被干涸水道切割，分布着许多封闭洼地。

english:
Shal'skii belongs to the lake and forest country around Onega in the Russian north. Waterways offered the most practical connections between scattered settlements, while winter conditions could create different routes across frozen ground and ice. Fishing, small scale farming, woodland work, and the movement of goods through lake landings supported local livelihoods. Communities needed to adapt their labour to short growing seasons and to the opportunities provided by extensive forests and fresh water.

Records of 1582–83 mention villages along the Shala associated with the Shalsky church district near the mouth of the Vodla. A local museum account describes a trading settlement there and a monastery boat that arrived in summer with supplies and returned carrying fish. These traces show how fishing and water transport connected the eastern shore of Lake Onega with religious and commercial networks. The modern settlement of Shal'skii later grew from several communities in this area.
simp_chinese:
沙尔斯基属于奥涅加湖周围的俄罗斯北部湖泊森林地带。水路是分散聚落之间最实用的联系，冬季冰封又可能在冻土和湖面形成另一套通道。捕鱼、小规模农业、林业劳动以及湖岸登陆点的货物流动，共同维持地方生计。居民需要根据短暂的生长季节安排劳动，同时利用广大森林和淡水环境提供的资源。

1582至1583年的文书记载了沙拉河两岸的村庄，属于沃德拉河口附近的沙尔斯基教区。当地博物馆的研究提到这里的贸易聚落：修道院船只夏季运来补给，返程时载走鱼货。这些记录显示，捕鱼与水运把奥涅加湖东岸同宗教和商业网络连接起来。现代沙尔斯基聚落则在后来由这一地区的多个居民点发展而成。

english:
Şamaxi lies in the foothill country of Shirvan, where routes between the Caucasus interior and the Caspian world supported an important town. Markets connected agricultural production with crafts and long-distance trade. Silk and other regional goods helped give Shirvan commercial significance, while merchants and travelers linked the town to neighboring Iranian and Caucasian centers. Its position also exposed it to the ambitions of rulers seeking revenues and control over movement.

Şamaxi served as a capital of the Shirvanshahs during the Middle Ages. The Safavids took the town in 1500–1501 and made Shirvan a directly governed province in 1538, with Şamaxi as its capital. In 1721 the city was sacked amid rebellion and many inhabitants were killed. Its silk trade and location on routes across the Caucasus tied local fortunes to wider political and commercial struggles.
simp_chinese:
沙马基位于希尔凡山麓，连接高加索内陆与里海世界的道路支持重要城镇。市场把农业生产同工艺和长途贸易相连。丝绸等地方商品使希尔凡具有商业价值，商人与旅客把城市连接到邻近伊朗及高加索中心。其位置也吸引追求收入和交通控制的统治者。

中世纪，沙马基曾是希尔凡沙王朝的都城。萨法维王朝于1500至1501年占领此地，1538年将希尔凡改为直接管辖的行省，以沙马基为首府。1721年，叛乱军劫掠城市，许多居民遇害。丝绸贸易和横贯高加索的道路，使当地命运同更广阔的政治商业争夺紧密相连。

english: Shambala lies in the Usambara highlands, where wooded hills rise above the dry plains of northeastern Tanzania. The Shambaa cultivated the mountain slopes and formed a kingdom under rulers of the Kilindi lineage. Tradition recalls Mbegha, a hunter who gained followers among local communities, as the kingdom's founder. His successors built their capital at Vugha and extended their authority among the mountain settlements.
simp_chinese: 尚巴拉位于乌桑巴拉高地，林木覆盖的山丘高出坦桑尼亚东北部干旱平原。尚巴人在山坡上耕作，并在基林迪家族统治下建立王国。传统记得猎人姆贝加赢得当地社群追随，是王国的创建者。其继承者在武加建立都城，将权威扩展到山地聚落之间。

english: Shambe lies on the western side of the Bahr al-Jabal, the upper White Nile, at the edge of the great Sudd wetlands. The river spreads into channels, lagoons and seasonally flooded grasslands as it flows north. Dinka cattle keepers use the surrounding country, moving their herds as the waters rise and fall. North of Shambe the Bahr el Zeraf branches away, adding another waterway to the maze of the Sudd.
simp_chinese: 沙姆贝位于白尼罗河上游山河的西侧，处在广大苏德湿地边缘。河水向北流时分散成水道、潟湖和季节洪泛草地。丁卡牧民利用周围土地，随着水位涨落转移牛群。沙姆贝以北，扎拉夫河从主流分出，为苏德迷宫般的水网增添另一条水道。

english: Shamiran is a mountain fortress in Tarom, overlooking the valley of the Qezel Uzan, the river that becomes the Safidrud farther downstream. The castle was a seat of the Justanid rulers and later counted among the fortresses occupied by the Ismailis. Its position in the rugged country between the plateau and the Caspian lowlands gave its defenders command of an important river passage.
simp_chinese: 沙米兰是塔罗姆地区的一座山地堡垒，俯瞰克孜尔乌赞河谷；这条河在下游成为萨菲德河。堡垒曾是朱斯塔尼德统治者的驻地，后来也被列为伊斯玛仪派占据的城堡之一。它坐落在高原与里海低地之间崎岖的山地，使守军能够控制重要的河谷通道。

english:
Shamkir belongs to the fertile country west of the Kura valley, where routes connect the southern Caucasus with the approaches to Georgia and the Iranian plateau. Cultivated land, pasture and river crossings supported settlement and trade. Medieval towns in this region drew on the movement of merchants and on agricultural production, while fortifications reflected the insecurity of a landscape crossed by competing powers.

Medieval Shamkir stood on the Shamkirchay and possessed a fortress and citadel. It prospered on a long-distance trade route until Mongol forces destroyed it in the thirteenth century; its remains lie east of the present city. In the early nineteenth century German settlers established Annenfeld in the wider district. The medieval ruins and modern settlement should be distinguished when interpreting the name.
simp_chinese:
沙姆基尔属于库拉河谷以西的肥沃地区，道路把南高加索连接到格鲁吉亚方向及伊朗高原。耕地、牧场和渡河地点支持定居与贸易。当地中世纪城镇依靠商人流动及农业生产发展，防御设施则体现竞争势力反复经过造成的不安全环境。居民需要同时应对生产需要与政治压力。

中世纪沙姆基尔位于沙姆基尔河畔，拥有堡垒和内城，依靠远程贸易路线繁荣，十三世纪被蒙古军队摧毁。遗址在现今城市以东。十九世纪初，德国移民在这一地区建立安嫩费尔德；理解地名时应区分中世纪遗址与后来城市。

english:
At the meeting of the North and West Branches of the Susquehanna stood Shamokin, a town whose name has been rendered as the Place of Eels. Canoe routes and paths converged here, including the Great Warriors Path leading north and the Great Shamokin Path crossing the mountains to Kittanning. By the eighteenth century it was a meeting place for peoples displaced from other parts of the region, among them Lenape, Shawnee, Conoy and Tutelo.

The Oneida leader Shikellamy represented Haudenosaunee interests in the Susquehanna valley and worked with the interpreter Conrad Weiser in dealings with Pennsylvania. Shamokin became a centre of trade and diplomacy, and Moravian missionaries established a smithy there in 1747. The outbreak of the French and Indian War brought an end to the town: its inhabitants left, and in 1756 colonial troops began building Fort Augusta on the site.
simp_chinese:
萨斯奎哈纳河北支与西支的交汇处曾有沙莫金，其名字被译为“鳗鱼之地”。独木舟航道与众多小径在此汇合，其中大勇士之路通向北方，大沙莫金之路则越过群山抵达基塔宁。到十八世纪，这里成为从地区其他地方迁来的各族人民的聚居地，包括勒纳佩人、肖尼人、科诺伊人和图特洛人。

奥奈达首领希克拉米在萨斯奎哈纳河谷代表豪德诺索尼的利益，并与译员康拉德·魏泽合作处理同宾夕法尼亚的往来。沙莫金成为贸易和外交中心，摩拉维亚传教士于1747年在那里建立铁匠铺。法印战争爆发后，居民离开了城镇；1756年，殖民地军队开始在原址修筑奥古斯塔堡。

english: The northern Shan Hills form a tangle of ridges and steep valleys between the Irrawaddy and Salween basins. The Namtu cuts westward across the highlands, breaking through the watershed on its way towards the Irrawaddy. Forest covers much of the mountain country, while flatter valleys provide places for cultivation. To the north, parallel ranges extend towards the Shweli River and the Yunnan frontier.
simp_chinese: 北部掸邦丘陵位于伊洛瓦底江与萨尔温江流域之间，山脊交错，河谷陡峭。南渡河横穿高地向西流去，切开分水岭，最终通往伊洛瓦底江。森林覆盖大部分山区，较平坦的谷地则适合耕作。北面一系列平行山岭延伸至瑞丽江和云南边疆。

sources.title: shan state part i volume i.pdf

english: The forested hills between the Salween and the Lancang form a rugged part of the Shan uplands. Here steep valleys divide communities whose villages stand above their fields. The Wa have long inhabited these mountains, cultivating the slopes and maintaining local traditions distinct from those of the Tai rulers of neighboring basins. Paths over the ridges connect the upland villages with markets and settlements in the lower valleys.
simp_chinese: 萨尔温江与澜沧江之间，林木茂密的山岭构成掸地高原崎岖的一部分。陡峭河谷隔开各处聚落，村寨坐落在耕地上方。佤族长期居住于这些山中，开垦山坡，并保有有别于邻近盆地傣族土司的地方传统。翻越山岭的小路连接高地村寨与低谷中的市集和聚落。

english: The Shan Hills extend across a broad plateau east of Burma's central plains. Ridges and valleys break up the uplands, and rivers have cut deep courses through the high country. This part of the range lies among the southern Shan states, where the landscape alternates between wooded slopes and valleys suitable for settlement. The mountains form part of the greater system of ranges stretching southward through mainland Southeast Asia.
simp_chinese: 掸邦丘陵横跨缅甸中部平原以东的广大高原。山脊和谷地将高地切割开来，河流在高地间凿出深邃河道。这段山地位于掸邦南部诸土邦之间，林木覆盖的坡地与适宜定居的谷地交错分布。它也是向南延伸、贯穿东南亚大陆的广大山系的一部分。

english: Shana stands at a river mouth on Etorofu's northwestern shore, beside a bay facing the Sea of Okhotsk. An Ainu settlement occupied this coast before the Japanese shogunate established a post here in 1800. Officials and guards oversaw the island's fisheries and administration. In 1807 Russian forces attacked and burned the post, a violent episode in the growing rivalry between Japan and Russia in the southern Kurils.
simp_chinese: 纱那位于择捉岛西北岸的河口，濒临鄂霍次克海的海湾。幕府于1800年在此设会所之前，海岸已有阿伊努人聚落。官员与守兵管理岛上渔场及事务；1807年俄国人袭击并烧毁会所，是日俄在南千岛竞争中的一次暴力事件。

english: Shana Bukanda lies near Kasaji on the Lunda plateau. The plateau forms part of the divide between the Kasai and Zambezi basins, with a northern slope descending towards the Congo. To the west, Lunda rulers built a network of dependent chiefdoms; their copper trade reached towards the Atlantic in the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries.
simp_chinese: 沙纳布坎达位于隆达高原上，靠近卡萨吉。高原是开赛河与赞比西河流域的分水岭之一，北坡下降至刚果盆地。西面的隆达统治者建立了附属酋邦的网络，十七和十八世纪，其铜贸易向大西洋方向延伸。

english: Shandan lies in the Hexi Corridor beneath the Qilian Mountains. South of the town, the broad Damaying grasslands furnished pasture for one of the region's great horse-breeding grounds. The western end of the grassland opens toward the Dadou Pass, a route between the corridor and Qinghai. In the Ming period the official Yang Yiqing proposed rebuilding the fort and facilities at Damaying, recruiting soldiers to tend the horses. The grasslands were valuable both for raising mounts and for guarding the approaches to the frontier.
simp_chinese: 山丹位于河西走廊，南倚祁连山。城南广阔的大马营草滩是当地重要的养马之地，草滩西端的大斗拔谷则连接河西与青海。明代督理马政的杨一清奏请重建大马营城堡和牧场设施，招募军人牧马。这里的草地既可培育军马，也有助于守卫通往边地的道路。

english: The Shandrin flows along the eastern side of the Kondakov Plateau toward the lower Indigirka. In its lower course it meanders across the flat northern country, where lakes and wetlands spread toward the East Siberian Sea. The river's name is associated with a Yukaghir group recorded in the Indigirka region, whose homeland included the Shandrin basin.
simp_chinese: 尚德林河沿孔达科夫高原东侧流向因迪吉尔卡河下游。河流下游在平坦的北方大地上蜿蜒，湖泊和湿地向东西伯利亚海方向延展。河名与因迪吉尔卡地区记载的一支尤卡吉尔人有关，其居住地包括尚德林河流域。

english: Shanfana lies near the upper Kasai in the highlands of eastern Angola. The Kasai rises on the Bié plateau and flows east before turning north towards the Congo. In the wider country live Chokwe communities, whose carved masks include the cikungu, associated with a chief's ancestors.
simp_chinese: 尚法纳位于安哥拉东部高地，靠近开赛河上游。开赛河发源于比耶高原，向东流后转向北方，流往刚果河。广阔的地区生活着乔奎人社群，他们雕刻的面具包括与首领祖先相联系的奇昆古面具。

english: Shangaly stands in the valley of the Ustya, a river of the northern forests that joins the Vaga on its way to the Northern Dvina. In the sixteenth century it was the centre of the Ustyanskaya district, also known as the Vvedensky #italic stan#!. This was the largest of five districts along the Ustya and included several taxable divisions, among them Shangalskaya. The village and its neighbours formed part of an established network of rural communities in the forested north.
simp_chinese: 尚加利位于乌斯季亚河谷；这条北方森林中的河流汇入瓦加河，河水最终流向北德维纳河。十六世纪时，尚加利是乌斯季扬斯卡亚地方区的中心，该区又称弗韦坚斯基区，是乌斯季亚河沿岸五个地方区中最大的一个，下辖若干纳税单位，其中便有尚加利单位。村庄及其邻地构成了北方林区乡村网络的一部分。

english: Shangcai takes its name from Cai, a state whose ancient capital occupied this part of the southern Henan plain. Later generations preserved the memory of its old sites in local gazetteers. A Qing compiler distinguished monuments still visible in his day from places known only by name, such as the supposed residence of the Qin statesman Li Si. East of the town lay Shitai, a mound traditionally associated with Fuxi and the creation of the eight trigrams.
simp_chinese: 上蔡因古蔡国而得名，周代蔡国都城曾位于这一带。后世县志保存了许多古迹的传说。清代修志者将当时尚存的遗迹与只留名称的地点分开记述，秦相李斯故宅便属于后者。城东的蓍台则相传为伏羲画八卦之处。

english: Shangcheng lies among the hills north of the Dabie Mountains. In the wooded valleys to the south, the Chan master Wunian founded Fayan Temple on Huangbai Mountain in 1593. He gathered disciples to clear the site and teach there, drawing visitors from literary and official circles. The monastery became a well-known religious centre in the mountain country between Henan and Hubei.
simp_chinese: 商城位于大别山北侧的丘陵之间。1593年，禅师无念在南部山谷的黄柏山创建法眼寺，率弟子开辟寺址、讲经授徒，也吸引文人与官员来访。寺院后来成为河南与湖北之间山地的重要佛教中心。

english:
Shangdang is a historical name associated with the high basin of southeastern Shanxi. The ancient commandery and later administrative units did not necessarily share the same boundaries. Cultivated valleys and surrounding mountains formed a landscape connected to neighbouring basins and the North China Plain by upland routes and passes.

Under the Ming and Qing, the wider Lu'an region formed part of the imperial administrative system. Officials handled revenue, law and communication, while markets, lineages and religious institutions also shaped rural life. Mountain routes carried people and goods between districts.
simp_chinese:
上党是与山西东南部高地盆地有关的历史名称。古代上党郡与后来的行政区边界并不必然相同。耕作河谷和周围山地构成当地景观，高地道路与山口将这里连接到邻近盆地和华北平原。

明清时期，潞安地区纳入帝国行政体系，地方官员负责税收、司法和与上级的联系。集镇、宗族与宗教机构也影响乡村生活，山间道路则为人员和货物往来提供通道。

english:
Shangdu, known to distant travellers as Xanadu, rises on the grasslands north of the Great Wall. Designed by Liu Bingzhong for Kublai Khan, the city brought together a walled palace, an imperial city and an outer city within a wider landscape of camps and hunting grounds. Mountains stand to the north and the upper Luan River flows to the south. Here Mongol court traditions met the architecture and institutions of settled China.

Kublai took the title of Great Khan at the city in 1260, and it became the summer capital of the Yuan dynasty. Each year the court travelled between Shangdu and Dadu, receiving princes and envoys and conducting government amid the grasslands. The city's palaces and gardens impressed visitors, including Marco Polo. In 1359 Red Turban rebels entered Shangdu and burned its palaces. After the Ming took Dadu in 1368, the Yuan emperor withdrew north to Shangdu, but Ming forces captured the city the following year. The court retreated farther into the steppe, leaving the summer capital behind.
simp_chinese:
上都位于长城以北的草原，远方旅人称之为香都。刘秉忠奉忽必烈之命设计这座城市，以宫城、皇城和外城为主体，周围分布着营帐与猎场。北面群山环绕，南面有滦河上游流过；蒙古宫廷传统在这里与中国定居社会的建筑和制度相遇。

1260年，忽必烈在此即大汗位，上都后来成为元朝夏都。朝廷每年往返于上都与大都之间，在草原上接见宗王、使节并处理政事。宫殿园林令马可·波罗等访客印象深刻。1359年红巾军攻入上都，焚毁宫阙。1368年明军夺取大都后，元帝北撤上都；次年明军攻占此城，朝廷又退往更北的草原，留下这座昔日夏都。

english:
Shanggao was a county of Ruizhou in western Jiangxi, where the Jin River ran between the county town and surrounding hills. Established in 952, it remained under Ruizhou through the Yuan, Ming and Qing, even as that superior administration changed from a circuit to a prefecture. South of the town, Mengshan gave the county an unusually valuable industry: silver and lead mining. A silver works was established there in 1200, and production expanded under the Yuan.

By 1337 Mengshan's richest phase was already passing. Its special supervisory office had been abolished in 1325, placing the works directly under Ruizhou. Silver ingots dated 1335 and 1350 bear the words 'Mengshan silver tax' and record the officials, furnace households and silversmiths responsible for them. These inscriptions reveal the many hands involved in turning ore into imperial revenue. A mine collapse brought another closure in 1350. Later attempts to revive production encountered depleted deposits. The abandoned workings and great accumulations of slag marked a countryside whose history included difficult underground labor as well as the fields and waterways of Jiangxi.
simp_chinese:
上高位于江西西部，锦江流经县城与周围丘陵之间。952年设县以后，元、明、清各代都隶属瑞州，尽管上级机构由路改为府，县的归属仍然延续。县城以南的蒙山则带来了一项价值可观的产业：银铅矿采冶。1200年当地设置银场，元代生产规模进一步扩大。

到1337年，蒙山最兴盛的阶段已经过去。专门督办银课的提举司于1325年撤销，银场改归瑞州路直接管理。1335年与1350年的银锭上刻有“蒙山银课”，还记下经办官员、炉户及销银匠的姓名，把地方官署、银场库役与实际从事熔炼的工匠一同记录下来，显示矿石转化为朝廷税收所经过的多层人手。1350年，矿洞坍塌导致银场再度封闭，后世复采又面临矿藏枯竭。废弃坑道与庞大炉渣堆留下了采冶活动的痕迹；这片江西乡土的历史，除了田畴水道，也包含艰苦的井下劳作。

english:
Shanghai became a county under Songjiang Prefecture in 1292, with its seat beside the Huangpu River. By the middle of the sixteenth century, cotton textiles had made the town part of one of China's busiest manufacturing districts. Its waterfront on the Huangpu linked these workshops and the surrounding countryside with coastal shipping, joining the river traffic of Jiangnan to the sea. Prosperity also exposed the county town to attack: repeated pirate raids prompted the construction of a defensive wall in 1553.

The wall acquired a religious life of its own. During the Wanli reign, a shrine to Guan Yu was built on a gate platform; in 1815 the Dajing platform received a three-storey temple pavilion. An inscribed stone gateway added in 1836 gave the complex its name, Dajing, or 'Great Prospect'. Meanwhile the establishment of a customs office in 1685 strengthened Shanghai's role in regulated maritime commerce. Inside the walls, the official Pān Yǔnduān began laying out the Yù Garden in 1559.
simp_chinese:
1292年，上海设县，隶属松江府，县治坐落于黄浦江畔。到十六世纪中叶，棉纺织业已使这里成为中国最繁忙的手工业地区之一。黄浦江沿岸的码头把作坊、周围乡村与沿海航运连接起来，使江南内河交通与海运在这里衔接。商贸兴盛的县城也遭受海盗侵扰，接连发生的倭寇袭击促成了1553年的筑城工程。

这些防御设施逐渐融入县城生活，城墙上也出现了宗教建筑。万历年间，城门箭台上建起供奉关羽的殿宇；1815年，大境台上又增建三层杰阁。1836年增设的石牌坊题有“大千胜境”，殿阁因此得名“大境”。与此同时，1685年海关的设立，加强了上海在受官府管理的海上贸易中的地位。城内的豫园，则是官员潘允端于1559年开始营建的园林。

english: Shàngháng lies in the hills of western Fújiàn on the Tīng River, which runs south to join the Hán River in Guǎngdōng. It began in 769 as a station cut from Lóngyán, became a county in 994, and under the Yuán, Míng and Qīng belonged to Tīngzhōu, in the Míng and Qīng one of its eight Hakka counties, whose prefecture seat lay upriver at Chángtīng. Through these centuries it remained a county of the Tīng River valley, part of the Hakka-speaking country of the Fújiàn-Guǎngdōng border.
simp_chinese: 上杭位于福建西部丘陵间的汀江岸边，汀江南流，汇入广东的韩江。唐大历四年（769年）自龙岩划出置上杭场，北宋淳化五年（994年）升县。元、明、清三代，上杭同属汀州，明清时是汀州府八个客家县之一，府治在上游的长汀。在这几百年里，上杭始终是汀江流域的一县，属于闽粤边界的客家地区。

english: Shanghe is an old county town on the northern Shandong plain. Its earthen inner wall, said to have been begun in the Tang, enclosed a roughly oval town with four gates. Ming and Qing officials repaired the fortifications over the centuries. Inside stood the county offices, the Confucian temple, Fusheng Temple and the Kuixing Pavilion; the county seat lay in the northeastern corner, with offices and a prison nearby.
simp_chinese: 商河是山东北部平原上的古县城。内城墙为土筑，相传始建于唐代，城形近椭圆，设有四门；明清两代屡加修缮。城内有县署、文庙、福胜寺和奎星阁等建筑，县署位于东北隅，附近设有官署与监狱。

english: Shàngjīn lies near the border of Húběi and Shǎnxī, where the Jīnqián River reaches a small plain on its way to the Hàn. A county was established here in early imperial times, and the walled town guarded an approach through the mountains. During the late Míng, the rebel leaders Lǐ Zìchéng and Zhāng Xiànzhōng used this country as a base.
simp_chinese: 上津位于湖北与陕西交界，金钱河在流向汉江途中冲出一片平地。古代这里曾设县，城池扼守山间通道。明末，李自成和张献忠曾以这一带作为活动根据地。

english: Shangjing, or Huining, was the first capital of the Jurchen Jin dynasty, established near the Ashi River after Aguda founded the state in 1115. Its walled city contained an imperial precinct and palace buildings as well as quarters for the wider population. In 1153 the court moved south to Zhongdu, and the old palaces and great residences were later ordered demolished. Though its time as the seat of empire ended before 1337, the ruined capital remained a landmark of Jurchen origins in the northeastern plain.
simp_chinese: 上京会宁府是女真金朝的首都，位于阿什河附近。1115年阿骨打建国后，这里成为都城，城垣内既有皇城和宫殿，也有普通居民的居所。1153年，朝廷南迁中都，旧宫殿与贵族宅第后来奉命拆毁。虽然上京作为帝国都城的时代在1337年以前便已结束，故城遗址仍是东北平原上女真王朝起源的见证。

english: Shànglín lies beneath the mountains of central Guangxi, where ridges descending from Dàmíng Mountain rise above the county town. Established under the Tang from land formerly belonging to Lǐngfāng, the county came under Bīnzhōu during the Song. The Yuan and Ming retained that relationship, and in 1369 Bīnzhōu became subordinate to Liǔzhōu Prefecture. The county gazetteer describes the mountain chain approaching the town through a succession of named peaks, giving its setting a distinctive place in local geography.
simp_chinese: 上林位于广西中部山麓，大明山延伸而来的群峰高踞县城之上。唐初从领方析地设上林县，宋代改属宾州，元明沿袭。明洪武二年（1369年），宾州归柳州府管辖。县志细数山脉沿途诸峰，描绘它们如何连绵而来，成为县城的重要地理背景。

english: Shangluo lies in the Dan River valley east of Shangzhou. The ancient settlement of Shang was traditionally associated with Xie, an ancestor of the Shang dynasty, and with Shang Yang, the Qin reformer granted lands in the region. Shang County was renamed Shangluo under the Sui, and its seat moved to Shangzhen in the Tang. In 1154 the Jin reduced Shangluo to a town and absorbed its territory into neighbouring Upper Luo County, the seat of Shangzhou.
simp_chinese: 商洛位于商州以东的丹江河谷。古商邑相传与商族先祖契有关，秦国变法之臣商鞅也曾受封于这一带。隋代商县改名商洛，唐代县治迁至商镇。1154年金朝将商洛县降为镇，其辖地并入西邻州治上洛县。

english: Shangnan lies among the wooded mountains of southeastern Shaanxi, in the country south of Shangzhou. The district belonged to the ancient county of Shang, and a county called Nanshang existed here under the Northern Wei. In 1477 the Ming established Shangnan County from the southern part of Shang County, taking its seat at Cengfeng post station. Its name recalls its position in the southern portion of the larger Shangzhou region.
simp_chinese: 商南位于陕西东南部林木茂密的群山之间，地处商州以南。这里古属商县，北魏时曾置南商县。1477年，明朝从商县南部析置商南县，以层峰驿为治所。县名体现了它位于商州地区南部的地理位置。

english:
Shangrao stands on the Xin River in northeastern Jiangxi, among routes leading east toward Zhejiang and north toward the Yangtze basin. As the seat of Guangxin Prefecture, the town administered a district of river valleys and mountains. On the south bank of the Xin stood an academy dedicated to learning and the memory of the Song philosopher Zhu Xi.

In 1360 Hu Dahai, a general serving Zhu Yuanzhang, captured Xinzhou and renamed it Guangxin Prefecture. Under the Qing, the academy was repaired in 1743 and named Ziyang in honour of Zhu Xi. A prefect enlarged it in 1781, when it took the name Xinjiang Academy. Its halls became a place for students to gather beside the river.
simp_chinese:
上饶位于赣东北信江之滨，东通浙江，北接长江流域。作为广信府治，它管辖周围河谷与山地。信江南岸建有书院，供士人讲学，也纪念宋代理学家朱熹。

1360年，朱元璋部将胡大海攻取信州，改为广信府。清代1743年，知府修葺书院，以朱熹别号改称紫阳书院；1781年知府大加扩建，更名信江书院。江边的厅堂成为学子聚会读书之所。

english: Shangshui lies among the waterways of eastern Henan, near the Sha River. At Changshe, a nine-storey brick pagoda was erected in 1033, overlooking the river and the town of Xiaoyao on the opposite bank. Waterborne trade enriched families along the Sha: from the Kangxi reign, the Ye family at Dengcheng built a large compound containing residences, a pawnshop and grain stores.
simp_chinese: 商水位于河南东部的水网之间，靠近沙河。常社的九层砖塔建于1033年，隔河望着逍遥镇。沙河水运也使沿岸一些家族兴盛；清康熙年间起，邓城叶氏修建大型庄园，内有宅院、当铺和粮仓。

english: Shangsi lies north of the great wooded mountains of southern Guangxi. It was a native prefecture under the Yuan and Ming, governed by hereditary Huang chiefs. In 1505 the Ming replaced the hereditary ruler with an appointed official and attached Shangsi to Nanning. Resistance followed, and in 1522 an imperial official urged the restoration of native rule; the court agreed and again permitted the office to pass by inheritance.
simp_chinese: 上思位于广西南部的十万大山北麓。元明时期，上思为土州，由黄氏土官世袭。明弘治十八年（1505年），朝廷改派流官，划归南宁府；此后地方发生反抗。嘉靖元年（1522年），官员建议恢复土官治理，朝廷采纳，重新允许世袭。

english: Shàngxī was one of the hereditary native jurisdictions in the mountain country of western Hunan, associated with the larger Yǒngshùn chiefship. Local rulers held office over communities scattered among the valleys of the upper Xīzhōu region. In 1727 the Shàngxī native magistrate Zhāng Hànrú surrendered his jurisdiction as the Qing extended direct administration into the area. The government established Lóngshān County from Shàngxī and neighbouring native lands, beginning a wider reorganisation of Yǒngshùn.
simp_chinese: 上溪是湘西山地的世袭土官辖地，与势力较大的永顺土司相联系。地方首领治理着溪州上游山谷中的社群。雍正五年（1727年），上溪土知州张汉儒纳土归流，清廷以上溪及邻近土司地设龙山县，由此展开永顺地区更广泛的行政调整。

english: Shangyou lies in the hills west of Ganzhou, on the upper waters of the Zhang River. Under the Ming it belonged to Nan'an Prefecture, whose seat lay at Dayu to the south. The countryside included fortified settlements such as Yingqian, one of the earthen-walled towns built in southern Jiangxi during an unsettled age. These enclosures resembled small county towns in their defences and offered local people a place of refuge amid the conflicts that troubled the mountain districts.
simp_chinese: 上犹位于赣州以西的丘陵中，处于章水上游。明代这里属南安府，府治在南面的大庾。县中有营前等土城，属于赣南动荡时期修建的乡村防御聚落。这些围城形制近似小型县城，在山地发生冲突时可供居民避守。

english: Shangyu lies on the Cao'e River east of Shaoxing. The river and its temple recall Cao E, a young woman remembered for her devotion to her drowned father. A memorial was erected in the Han period, and later generations honoured her as a model of filial conduct. During the Ming, officials repaired her shrine and added other women to its commemorations, preserving the story in the county's ritual life.
simp_chinese: 上虞位于绍兴以东的曹娥江畔。江名与江边庙宇纪念曹娥：传说她为寻找溺水的父亲而投江，后世奉其为孝女。东汉时当地已立碑纪念，明代官员重修祠庙，又将其他女子列入祭祀，使这一故事继续留存在地方礼俗中。

english:
On the southern bank of the Yangtze where the river bends north toward the sea, the city today called Jiqing has been a capital and a stronghold for more than a thousand years. The ancient kings of Wú, the Eastern Jìn, and the southern dynasties of the post-Hàn age all ruled from its walls under the names #italic Jianye#! and #italic Jiankang#!, making it for centuries the cultural heart of southern China. When the Jurchen conquered the north in the 12th century the Sòng court briefly considered settling here as their new capital, and after the Mongols swept across the empire the city was rebuilt as the seat of Jiqing prefecture, its strategic position on the lower Yangtze ensuring its enduring importance among the cities of the south.

In 1356 Zhū Yuánzhāng took Jíqìng, renamed it Yìngtiān and made it the base of his war on the Yuán. When he proclaimed the Míng in 1368 it became for the first time the capital of all China, and the next year he began a vast new city wall around it, with his palace rising in Shàngyuán, the half of the city north of the Qínhuái River. Some 700,000 people lived here in the early Míng, 200,000 of them garrison troops. Its primacy lasted barely half a century: his son Zhū Dì, Prince of Yān, took the city from his nephew in 1402, and in 1421 moved the court to Běijīng, leaving Yìngtiān a secondary capital with six ministries of its own. When Běijīng fell in 1644, a Southern Míng court was set up here. The Qīng took it in 1645, renamed it Jiāngníng, and made it the seat of the viceroy who governed Jiāngsū, Ānhuī and Jiāngxī.
simp_chinese:
长江折向北汇入大海的弯曲处南岸，这座如今被称为集庆的城市，千年来曾多次成为首都。古代的孙吴、东晋以及诸南朝，皆以#italic 建业#!和#italic 建康#!之名在此建都，使其在数个世纪中成为南方中国的文化心脏。12世纪女真人征服北方时，宋廷曾短暂考虑在此定都；蒙古帝国席卷天下后，该城被重建为集庆府的治所，其位于长江下游的战略位置确保了它在南方诸城中持久的重要性。

1356年朱元璋攻占集庆，改名应天，以此为反元的根据地。1368年他建立明朝，应天第一次成为统一王朝的京城；次年开始修筑规模宏大的新城墙，皇宫就建在秦淮河以北的上元县境内。明初京城约有70万人，其中卫戍部队就有20万。都城的地位只维持了半个世纪：1402年，他的儿子燕王朱棣从侄子手中夺下此城和皇位，1421年迁都北京，应天降为陪都，仍保留一套六部。1644年北京陷落后，南明朝廷在这里建立。1645年清军攻占此城，改为江宁府，此后这里一直是统辖江苏、安徽、江西三省的两江总督驻地。

english: Shangzhou occupies the upper Dan River valley amid the eastern Qinling. Its seat was the ancient county of Upper Luo, and the prefecture took its name from nearby Mount Shang. The road from Chang'an through Lantian and Wu Pass crossed this region, linking the capital with the southeast. Tradition remembered Mount Shang as the retreat of four elderly sages who withdrew from Qin rule. The Yuan absorbed Upper Luo County into Shangzhou. In 1374 the Ming reduced the prefecture to a county, then restored it as a prefecture in 1477. Under the Qing it was raised to a directly administered prefecture in 1725, governing surrounding mountain districts from the old town in the Dan valley.
simp_chinese: 商州位于秦岭东段的丹江上游河谷，州治为古上洛县，州名则来自附近的商山。长安经蓝田、武关通往东南的道路穿过此地；传说秦末四位隐士曾隐居商山，后世称为商山四皓。元代上洛县并入商州。明朝于1374年降州为县，1477年又恢复州制。清代于1725年将商州升为直隶州，从丹江河谷的古城管辖周围山地。

english: The Cheyenne River crosses the plains east of the Black Hills after receiving the Belle Fourche, its largest tributary. The Belle Fourche comes from Wyoming and swings around the northern side of the hills before joining the Cheyenne. Beyond the junction the combined river runs east toward the Missouri. The surrounding drainage contains rolling plains, isolated buttes and intermittent streams as well as broken badland formations.
simp_chinese: 夏延河接纳其最大支流贝尔富尔什河后，流过黑山东面的平原。贝尔富尔什河从怀俄明而来，绕过黑山北侧，与夏延河汇合。合流后的河水继续向东奔向密苏里河。周围流域有起伏的平原、孤立的山丘和季节性溪流，也有地形破碎的恶地。

english: Shanjir belongs to the traditions of the Circassians of the northwestern Caucasus. It is remembered as the seat of Prince Inal, a figure associated with the unification of Circassian lands in the fifteenth century. Its name survives in accounts of a political centre among the peoples of the Kuban and Black Sea country, where local princes negotiated their power amid wider regional rivalries.
simp_chinese: 尚吉尔属于西北高加索切尔克斯人的历史传统。它被记作伊纳尔亲王的驻地；这位人物与十五世纪切尔克斯诸地的统一相联系。这一名称留存在有关库班河与黑海一带政治中心的记述中。当时地方诸侯在更广泛的地区争夺中维系各自的权力。

english: Shankargarh, also called Kasauta, lies southwest of Prayag near the Vindhyan uplands. The local rajas traced their descent from the Baghel rulers of Rewa. Nearby Garhwa contains remains of temples and inscriptions from the Gupta age, together with a carved image of Vishnu's ten incarnations. Around 1750 Vishwanath Singh Deo of Rewa fortified the old temple ruins with a square enclosure and parapets, creating the site known as Garhwa Fort.
simp_chinese: 申卡尔格尔又称卡绍塔，位于普拉亚格西南、靠近温迪亚高地的地方。当地王公自称是雷瓦巴格尔统治家族的后裔。附近的加尔瓦保存着笈多时代的寺庙遗迹和铭文，还有一块刻画毗湿奴十种化身的石雕。约1750年，雷瓦的维什瓦纳特·辛格·德奥在古寺废墟外围筑起方形围墙与胸墙，形成加尔瓦堡。

english: The Shannon broadens into a long tidal estuary between the shores of Clare and Kerry before meeting the Atlantic. Islands, creeks and sheltered anchorages break up its waters, while the river continues inland to Limerick. For ships bound to the city, the estuary was the gateway between the ocean and the commerce of the Shannon valley. Its entrance lies between exposed headlands, and vessels must contend with wind and tide before reaching the more protected water farther upstream. Control of this route mattered to the port of Limerick in peace and war.
simp_chinese: 香农河在克莱尔与凯里海岸之间拓宽为漫长的潮汐河口，然后汇入大西洋。岛屿、小湾与避风锚地分布其间，河流继续向内陆通往利默里克。对驶向该城的船只而言，河口是大洋与香农河谷贸易之间的门户。入口位于无遮蔽的岬角之间，船舶须应对风浪与潮流，才能抵达上游较受保护的水域。无论和平还是战争，控制这条航路对利默里克港都很重要。

english: Shanfu is an ancient town on the southwestern Shandong plain. In the Spring and Autumn period, Confucius's disciples Mi Zijian and Wuma Shi governed here, remembered respectively for ruling to the sound of a lute and for working late into the night. The county was absorbed into Shanzhou in 1368. Its old streets later became famous for carved memorial arches; among them, the stone Hundred Lions Arch was erected in 1778 in honour of a local widow.
simp_chinese: 单父是山东西南平原上的古城。春秋时，孔子弟子宓子贱与巫马施先后为单父宰，分别以“鸣琴而治”和“披星戴月”传为佳话。1368年，单父县并入单州。旧城街道后来以众多雕刻精美的牌坊闻名，其中百狮坊为表彰当地一位寡妇而于1778年建造。

english: The Shantar Islands lie in the Sea of Okhotsk, at the mouths of deep bays north of the lower Amur. Forested shores and steep cliffs face waters known for strong tides, fog and persistent ice. Russian expeditions reached the nearby coast in the seventeenth century, and the islands later appeared in accounts of exploration of the northern sea. Their position off Tugur Bay placed them among the coastal routes linking the Amur country with the Sea of Okhotsk.
simp_chinese: 尚塔尔群岛位于鄂霍次克海，在黑龙江下游以北多个深湾的出口附近。森林海岸和陡峭崖壁面向潮汐强烈、雾气频繁、冰期漫长的海域。十七世纪，俄国探险队抵达附近海岸，群岛后来出现在北方海域探查的记载中。它们位于图古尔湾外，处在连接黑龙江地区与鄂霍次克海的沿海路线上。

english: The Shantar Islands lie off the northwestern shore of the Sea of Okhotsk, near Uda and Tugur bays. Strong tides, fog and long-lasting ice shape the waters around the islands. Seals and whales frequent their coasts, while the channels between the islands connect the bays with the open sea. Russian surveyors explored the archipelago between 1711 and 1725.
simp_chinese: 尚塔尔群岛位于鄂霍次克海西北岸之外，靠近乌达湾和图古尔湾。强劲的潮汐、浓雾与长期不散的海冰塑造着群岛周围的水域。海豹和鲸出没于岛岸附近，岛间水道将海湾与外海相连。1711年至1725年间，俄国测绘人员曾勘察这片群岛。

english: Shantsa lies among the lakes and high mountains of southern Changtang. The snow-covered Shentsa Jekang range, a branch of the Gangdise, divides the district, while Gering Lake receives the waters of the Shentsa and Baru rivers. To the north lies the extensive Selin lake basin. Between these waters and peaks spread the high grazing lands of the Tibetan plateau.
simp_chinese: 香孜即申扎，位于羌塘南部的高山与湖泊之间。冈底斯山支脉申扎杰岗山终年积雪，将这一带分隔开来；格仁错汇集申扎藏布和巴汝藏布的水流，北面则有广阔的色林错盆地。湖泊与山峰之间，是青藏高原的高寒牧场。

english: Shan County occupies the old Shanzhou region on the southern bank of the Yellow River, where hills approach a narrow stretch of the river valley. In the southeastern part of the old town stood Baolun Temple and its brick pagoda, built under the Jin in the twelfth century. A curious echo gave the tower its popular name, the Toad Pagoda: a clap or struck stone nearby was said to return a sound like a frog's call.
simp_chinese: 陕县地处黄河南岸的古陕州一带，山丘靠近河谷，河道在此收窄。旧城东南有宝轮寺，寺中砖塔建于十二世纪的金代。人们在塔旁拍手或击石，回声听来像蛙鸣，因此这座古塔又有“蛤蟆塔”的俗称。

english: Shanyang lies among the mountains south of Shangzhou, in the valley formerly known as Fengyang. A county was established here under the Western Jin, and its name changed to Shanyang under the Ming. Farther southeast, Manchuan Pass guarded the approach between Shaanxi and the Han River country. In 1477 the Ming moved the Fengyang inspection post to the pass, while the county seat remained in the mountain valley to the northwest. The Qing later abolished the inspection post.
simp_chinese: 山阳位于商州以南的群山之间，所在河谷古称丰阳。西晋时此地置县，明代改名山阳。东南的漫川关扼守陕西通往汉水流域的道路。1477年，明朝将丰阳巡检司迁至此关，县治仍位于西北方的山谷中；清代后来撤销了巡检司。

english: Shānyáng was the county seat within the city of Huái’ān, at a key junction of the Grand Canal and the Huái River. During the Míng and Qīng, the governor-general of grain transport directed the movement of tribute grain from offices in the city. Warehouses and boatyards around nearby Qīngjiāngpǔ served the fleets travelling northward.
simp_chinese: 山阳县治位于淮安府城，是大运河与淮河附近的重要枢纽。明清时期，漕运总督在城中衙署统管漕粮运输；附近清江浦的仓库和船厂则为北上的漕船服务。

english: Shanyang was the county attached to Shuozhou, on the northern Shanxi plateau. Under the Yuan it shared the prefecture with Mayi, before being absorbed into Shuozhou in the early Ming. The old town’s Chongfu Temple reflected a much longer Buddhist history: its scripture hall was traditionally dated to the Tang, while later generations maintained the temple through the changing dynasties.
simp_chinese: 鄯阳是山西北部高原上朔州的附郭县。元代鄯阳与马邑同属朔州，明初并入州治。城中的崇福寺有更悠久的佛教历史：相传藏经阁始建于唐代，后世历经朝代更替，继续维护这座古寺。

english: Shanyin lies on the northern Shanxi plateau, between the mountains and the Sanggan River. The county received its name under the Jin in 1167 and was absorbed into neighbouring Jincheng in 1265. It was later restored at a new seat and placed under Yingzhou. Under the Ming and Qing, the county belonged to Datong prefecture, whose northern frontier faced the grasslands beyond the mountains.
simp_chinese: 山阴位于山西北部高原，地处山岭与桑干河之间。金大定七年（1167年）得名山阴，元至元二年（1265年）并入金城，后来在新址复置，隶属应州。明清时期，山阴属大同府，府境北部面向山外草原。

english: Shàowǔ stands on the Fùtún River in northwestern Fújiàn, on a route through the mountains toward Jiāngxī. In 979 the Sòng established Shàowǔ Military Prefecture and moved the county seat to the south bank of the river, where an earthen-walled town was built. Its position on the inland approach to Fújiàn made it a place of military importance.
simp_chinese: 邵武位于福建西北部的富屯溪畔，是穿越山岭通往江西的要道。北宋太平兴国四年（979年），朝廷设邵武军，并将县治迁至溪流南岸，筑土城作为军、县治所。其地处入闽的内陆通道，具有军事上的重要性。

english:
Shaoxing stands in the old country of Yue, between the Kuaiji Mountains and the lakes and canals of the coastal plain. King Goujian had built a fortress here in the 5th century BC, and the town took its present name in 1131, when Emperor Gaozong of Song, rallying his dynasty in the south, raised Yuezhou to Shaoxing Prefecture, named for his reign period. Jian Lake, made in the Han to collect mountain streams for irrigation, gave its water to the rice wine that Shaoxing is known for.

Under the Yuan the town was the seat of Shaoxing Circuit, and under the Ming and Qing it governed a prefecture of eight counties, two of which, Shanyin and Kuaiji, shared the city itself. Keeping the tidal waters of the Qiantang out of the fields was a standing task: in 1536 the prefect Tang Shaoen built the Sanjiang sluice to hold back the sea and keep fresh water in the inland channels. The prefecture also became known for its sons in government offices, from clerks to the private legal secretaries who served magistrates across the empire. In the 1520s the philosopher Wang Yangming lectured to his disciples here.
simp_chinese:
绍兴位于古越之地，处在会稽山与沿海平原的湖泊、运河之间。春秋时越王勾践曾在此筑城，现名则始于1131年：宋高宗在南方重整王朝，升越州为绍兴府，取年号为名。汉代修筑的鉴湖汇集山间溪水用于灌溉，也为绍兴的黄酒提供了水源。

元代这里是绍兴路治所，明清两代则是下辖八县的绍兴府，其中山阴、会稽两县同城而治。挡住钱塘江的咸潮、保住内河淡水是长久的要务：嘉靖十五年（1536年），知府汤绍恩修成三江闸，拒海水于闸外，使内河蓄住淡水。绍兴人也以在官府任职闻名，从书吏到各地州县衙门里的刑名师爷都有绍兴人。16世纪20年代，哲学家王阳明在绍兴向弟子讲学。

english: Shàoyáng stands on the southern bank of the Zī River in southwestern Húnán. Known as Bǎoqìng from the Southern Sòng onward, its walled city served as the seat of a prefecture through the Míng and Qīng. Temples, schools, and a princely residence stood within its streets, while the river connected the city with the valleys beyond.
simp_chinese: 邵阳位于湖南西南部资江南岸。南宋以来这里称宝庆，明清时期城中设府治。城内外有庙宇、学校和王府，资江则将城池与远处山谷相连。

english: Shapoquate lies in the former Great Black Swamp of northwestern Ohio, near the headwaters of the Portage River. Waterlogged woodland and marsh made the country difficult to cross or settle. A road through the swamp was completed in 1827 but soon became notorious for its mud. In 1832 a family settled at the site of Bowling Green, amid the wetlands that then covered the surrounding lowlands.
simp_chinese: 沙波夸特位于俄亥俄西北部昔日的大黑沼泽，靠近波蒂奇河源头。积水林地和沼泽使这片地区难以穿越和定居。1827年，一条穿过沼泽的道路完工，很快便因泥泞而臭名远扬。1832年，一户人家在鲍灵格林所在地定居，当时周围低地仍被湿地覆盖。

english: Shaqrud is a small settlement in the inland hills of Hormozgan, north of the Minab plain. The mountainous country separates the warm valleys leading to the coast from the higher districts of Kerman. Rivers descending through the region eventually reach the lowlands near the Strait of Hormuz. Here scattered villages occupy a landscape of ridges and valleys, part of the wider warm zone of southeastern Persia.
simp_chinese: 沙克鲁德是霍尔木兹甘内陆丘陵间的小聚落，位于米纳卜平原以北。山区将通向海岸的温暖河谷与克尔曼更高的地区分隔开来。流经这一带的河川从高地下降，最终抵达霍尔木兹海峡附近的低地。散落村庄坐落在山脊与河谷之间，属于波斯东南部广阔暖区的一部分。

english: The Shar is a steppe river flowing northward to the left bank of the Irtysh. Rising among the hills of eastern Kazakhstan, it crosses open country before reaching the greater river between the Altai foothills and Semey. Its flow is strongly seasonal: like other streams descending from the low hills, it can dwindle or break into separate pools in the dry months.
simp_chinese: 沙尔河是一条草原河流，向北流入额尔齐斯河左岸。它发源于哈萨克东部丘陵，流经开阔地带，在阿尔泰山麓与塞梅伊之间汇入大河。河水随季节显著变化；同其他源自低丘的河流一样，旱季水量可能减少，河道甚至断成一段段水洼。

english: Shar Yelpuk is a monastery in the high mountain country of Kham. Founded in 1171 by Yelpa Yeshe Tsek, it became the principal seat of the Yelpa Kagyu tradition, one of the smaller branches of Tibetan Buddhism's Kagyu school. The lineage later became closely associated with Tana monastery in Nangchen, connecting religious communities across the valleys of eastern Tibet.
simp_chinese: 夏尔巴此处指康区高山中的夏尔叶普寺。寺院由叶巴益西则于1171年创建，成为叶巴噶举派的主要驻锡地；这一传承是藏传佛教噶举派的小支系之一。后来它与囊谦达那寺关系密切，将藏东不同河谷的宗教社群联系起来。

english: Sharanga stands on the river of the same name, a tributary of the Usta in the forested Vetluga country. The settlement is recorded in 1747 on lands inhabited by Mari communities. Its name is associated with a Mari word for willow, recalling the trees beside its river. The Usta and Vetluga carry the waters of this district toward the Volga, while the forests around Sharanga preserve many place names inherited from the region’s earlier inhabitants.
simp_chinese: 沙兰加坐落在同名河畔；这条河是乌斯塔河的支流，属于韦特卢加森林地区。1747年的记录提到了这一聚落，它所在的土地有马里人居住。地名与马里语中的柳树一词有关，令人想起河边的树木。乌斯塔河和韦特卢加河将当地的水带向伏尔加河，而沙兰加周围森林中的许多地名承继自这一地区早期居民。

english:
Sharda lies beside the Neelum River in the mountains of Kashmir. Here stands Sharada Peeth, a temple dedicated to Sharada, the Kashmiri name for the goddess Saraswati. Once a celebrated centre of learning, it was known for a library that drew scholars from far away. The Sharada script takes its name from the institution, and Kashmir itself came to be called Sharada Desh, the country of Sharada.

The shrine was already a place of pilgrimage by the eighth century. The chronicler Jonaraja recounts that Sultan Zain-ul-Abidin visited it in 1422, seeking a vision of the goddess; she appeared to him in a dream after he had slept in the temple court. In the sixteenth century Abu'l-Fazl described the stone temple and the great reverence in which it was held.
simp_chinese:
沙尔达坐落在克什米尔山区的尼勒姆河畔。这里的舍拉达神庙供奉舍拉达，即克什米尔人对女神萨拉斯瓦蒂的称呼。神庙曾是著名的学术中心，其藏书吸引远方学者前来求学。舍拉达文字以这座学府命名，克什米尔也因此被称为舍拉达之地。

到八世纪时，这座神庙已是朝圣之所。编年史家乔纳拉阇记载，苏丹宰因·阿比丁于1422年前来，希望见到女神；他在神庙庭院睡下后，女神出现在他的梦中。十六世纪的阿布勒法兹勒描述了这座石庙，以及人们对它的崇敬。

english: Shardonem stands on a bend of the Pinega near the mouth of the Sharda, from which its name is derived. The river curves around the settlement, leaving it on a low peninsula. Documents of the seventeenth century record the local parish and a petition concerning rights to Lake Akazero and a meadow on the Sharda. The village belonged to the network of communities along the Pinega's forested banks.
simp_chinese: 沙尔多涅姆坐落在皮涅加河的弯道上，靠近沙尔达河口，地名即源于这条支流。河水绕过村庄，形成一处低矮半岛。十七世纪的文书记载了当地教区，以及有关阿卡泽罗湖和沙尔达河畔草场权利的请愿。村庄属于皮涅加河森林河岸上相互联系的社群之一。

english: Sharga Uul rises above the grasslands of eastern Mongolia, a landmark visible across the open steppe. Local herders have long revered the mountain, associating its good pasture with the prosperity of their animals. The yellowish mountain stands apart from the surrounding plain, giving travellers a point of orientation in a landscape of broad horizons. Its name and that of nearby Javkhlant preserve the importance of these heights in local tradition.
simp_chinese: 沙尔嘎山高出蒙古东部草原，在开阔原野上是远处可见的地标。当地牧民长期敬奉此山，将山上的良好牧草与牲畜兴旺联系起来。黄褐色山体从周围平原中突出，为穿行广阔草原的人指示方向。沙尔嘎山与附近贾夫赫兰特山的名字，保留了这些山峰在地方传统中的地位。

english: Shargyn Gobi is a dry basin in the western Mongolian desert, enclosed by the mountains of the Gobi Altai. Sparse desert-steppe plants grow on its plains, including feather grasses and low drought-resistant shrubs. Like much of the Gobi, this is a cold inland desert where bare ground and gravel are as characteristic as sand, and winter frost follows the brief warmer season.
simp_chinese: 沙尔金戈壁是蒙古西部荒漠中的干旱盆地，周围为戈壁阿尔泰山所围。平原上生长着稀疏的荒漠草原植物，包括针茅和低矮耐旱灌木。这里如同戈壁许多地方一样，是寒冷的内陆荒漠，裸地和砾石与沙地同样常见，短暂暖季过后便是冬日霜冻。

english: Shari lies on the coast of the Sea of Okhotsk near the Shiretoko Peninsula. Its name comes from an Ainu word for a place where reeds grow. In 1789 the local Ainu asked the Matsumae domain to send an official trading ship, and the Shari trading district was established the following year. In 1807 the Tsugaru domain sent more than a hundred men to guard the coast; poorly supplied for the northern winter, many died of illness.
simp_chinese: 斜里位于知床半岛附近的鄂霍次克海沿岸，地名来自阿伊努语中芦苇生长之处。1789年，当地阿伊努人请求松前藩派遣正式贸易船，次年斜里场所随之设立。1807年，津轻藩派百余人来守卫海岸，但他们缺乏足够物资过北方寒冬，许多人因病死亡。

english:
Sharjah lies on the sandy Arabian shore of the Persian Gulf. A coastal settlement with access to pearl banks, it also served as a place where goods arriving by sea could be exchanged with people of the desert. The town came under the authority of the Qawasim, whose ports and fleets made them a significant power in the lower Gulf.

Conflict between British ships and the Qawasim culminated in a British expedition in 1819. After destroying Ras al-Khaimah, the expedition attacked other ports, including Sharjah, where fortifications and larger vessels were destroyed. The following year Sultan bin Saqr al-Qasimi, ruler of Sharjah, signed the General Maritime Treaty with Britain along with other coastal sheikhs. The treaty called for an end to plunder at sea and required vessels to carry identifying documents. Sultan's association with Sharjah and the movement of supporting families to the town helped it grow after the destruction of the principal Qasimi port.
simp_chinese:
沙迦位于波斯湾阿拉伯海岸的沙地上。这座沿海聚落靠近珠场，也是海运货物与沙漠居民交换的地方。它处于卡瓦西姆家族的权威之下，后者凭借港口与船队成为海湾南部的重要势力。

英国船只与卡瓦西姆之间的冲突最终导致1819年的英国远征。远征军摧毁拉斯海马后，又攻击包括沙迦在内的其他港口，毁坏当地防御工事和较大的船只。次年，沙迦统治者苏丹·本·萨克尔·卡西米与其他沿海酋长一道同英国签订海上总条约。条约要求停止海上劫掠，并规定船只携带证明身份的文件。卡瓦西姆的主要港口遭毁后，苏丹与沙迦的联系以及支持他的家族迁入，推动了这座城镇的成长。

english: Shark Bay is a great inlet on the western Australian coast, partly enclosed by peninsulas and Dirk Hartog Island. In 1616 Dirk Hartog landed on that island and left a pewter plate recording his visit. William Dampier later entered the bay in 1699 and gave it the name by which it became known to European sailors.
simp_chinese: 沙克湾是澳大利亚西海岸的一座大海湾，部分由半岛和德克·哈托格岛环抱。1616年德克·哈托格登上该岛，留下记录其来访的锡盘。威廉·丹皮尔于1699年进入海湾，所起的名称此后为欧洲水手所知。

english: Sharka was one of the Muslim principalities of southern Ethiopia, a land noted for its livestock and connected with neighboring Dawaro. Small pieces of iron called hakuna served as money there and in nearby districts. Emperor Amda Seyon campaigned against Sharka in the fourteenth century, taking its ruler Yusuf captive and carrying off livestock. The principality became tributary to the Christian highland kingdom.
simp_chinese: 沙尔卡是埃塞俄比亚南部的穆斯林侯国之一，以牲畜众多著称，与邻近的达瓦罗相联系。当地及附近地区使用称为哈库纳的小铁片作为货币。十四世纪，皇帝阿姆达·塞永征讨沙尔卡，俘获其统治者优素福并掠走牲畜。此后，沙尔卡成为基督教高地王国的朝贡国。

english: Ras Sharma projects from the Hadramawt coast into the waters east of the Gulf of Aden. Behind its rocky headland stood the medieval port of Sharma, a place of warehouses and maritime exchange active from about 980 into the twelfth century. Pottery found there came from many parts of the Indian Ocean, including East Africa and China. The port's remains recall an earlier trading network along this exposed Arabian shore.
simp_chinese: 沙尔马角从哈德拉毛海岸伸入亚丁湾以东的水域。岩石岬地后方曾有中世纪港口沙尔马，一处仓库与海上交换地点，约980年至12世纪期间活跃。出土陶器来自印度洋多个地区，包括东非和中国。港口遗存留下了这片暴露的阿拉伯海岸早期贸易网络的痕迹。

english: Sharu lies in the high country of Qumarleb, near the upper Yangtze and the eastern edge of Hoh Xil. Sharu Monastery, whose name means “antler monastery”, stands among the Tibetan communities of this cold pastoral region. Rivers descend from the plateau towards the Drichu, while alpine grasslands provide habitat for wild yak and Tibetan antelope as well as grazing for herds.
simp_chinese: 夏如位于曲麻莱高地，靠近长江上游与可可西里东缘。夏如寺的名称意为“鹿角寺”，坐落在寒冷牧区的藏族社群之间。河流从高原流向哲曲，高山草地既为野牦牛和藏羚羊提供生境，也供牲畜放牧。

english: Sharuna lies in Middle Egypt near the Nile and the archaeological site of Kom el-Ahmar. The ancient town here was known as Hut-nesut, and its remains include tombs and a temple of the Ptolemaic period. Later Christian communities left a funerary church and the monastery of Deir el-Qarabin. These remains reveal a place occupied across successive periods of Egyptian history, between the fertile valley and the desert edge.
simp_chinese: 沙鲁纳位于埃及中部，靠近尼罗河及红丘考古遗址。这里的古城称为胡特内苏特，遗存包括墓葬和托勒密时期的神庙。后来的基督教群体留下了墓葬教堂和代尔卡拉宾修道院。这些遗迹展现了一处在埃及历史多个时期都有人居住的地方，坐落于肥沃河谷与沙漠边缘之间。

english:
Shasukotan, or Shiashkotan, lies near the middle of the Kuril island chain. Its two mountainous volcanic ends are joined by a narrow sandy isthmus. The island's name comes from an Ainu expression meaning “kelp village.” Ainu inhabitants lived by hunting and fishing when Europeans first encountered them.

A Japanese official map of 1644 included the island among territories associated with the Matsumae domain, and the Tokugawa shogunate confirmed those holdings in 1715. Russian expansion brought a competing claim from the north. Such maps and claims record the ambitions of outside governments, while the island remained part of an inhabited Ainu world.
simp_chinese:
舍子古丹位于千岛岛链中部附近，岛屿南北两端为火山山地，中间由狭窄的沙质地峡相连。岛名来自阿伊努语，意为“海带村”。欧洲人接触此岛时，岛上的阿伊努居民以渔猎为生。

1644年的日本官图把此岛列入与松前藩有关的领地，德川幕府于1715年确认其领有。俄国向南扩展后也提出竞争性主张。这些地图与主张记载的是外部政权的意图，而岛屿本身仍属于有人居住的阿伊努世界。

english: Shatili stands on the northern slopes of the Greater Caucasus in the historical Georgian region of Khevsureti. Its stone houses and towers are joined into a compact fortified complex above the Arghun River. The closely packed buildings served as both dwellings and a defensive barrier, protecting the mountain community and the approaches through the gorge. Shatili was once part of the Kingdom of Kakheti.
simp_chinese: 沙蒂利位于大高加索山脉北坡，属于格鲁吉亚历史上的赫夫苏列季地区。阿尔贡河上方的石屋与塔楼连成紧凑的设防建筑群。这些密集的建筑既是居所，也是防御屏障，保护山地社群及穿越峡谷的通道。沙蒂利曾属于卡赫季王国。

english:
Shatki belongs to the forested country south of the middle Volga, where rivers and patches of agricultural land supported rural settlement. Grain cultivation and livestock keeping combined with woodland resources, and village households relied on a seasonal rhythm of sowing, harvest and winter preparation. Paths and local waterways connected communities to market centres, though travel could become difficult during thaw and autumn rain. The availability of usable land and labour shaped the scale of farming.

Russian expansion and the consolidation of authority in the Volga region brought new settlements and changing landholding arrangements. Estates, religious institutions and state demands helped organize rural obligations, while Indigenous peoples of the wider region maintained distinct traditions and relationships. Trade connected farm products and local crafts with distant towns, though households remained dependent on the harvest. The development of serfdom affected freedom and duties in many agricultural districts.
simp_chinese:
沙特基属于伏尔加河中游以南的林地，河流和成片农业土地支撑乡村定居。谷物种植、畜牧与森林资源利用结合，家庭依据播种、收获和越冬准备的季节节律劳动。小径及地方水道把社群接入市场中心，解冻与秋雨期间交通却可能艰难。可用土地和劳动力多少决定农业规模。

俄罗斯扩张及其在伏尔加地区权力的巩固，带来新聚落与土地安排的变化。庄园、宗教机构和国家要求共同塑造乡村义务，更广地区的原住民族群仍维持自己的传统和关系。贸易将农产品及地方手工品送往远方城镇，家庭生计依然依赖收成。农奴制的发展也影响了许多农业地区居民的自由与义务。

english: Shatsk lies on the northern shore of Lake Liutsymer among the forests, marshes and lakes of northwestern Volhynia. It is first mentioned in 1410, when King Władysław Jagiełło sent hunters into the local forests to procure game for his army before the campaign against the Teutonic Order. By 1595 Shatsk was recorded as a town. Its lakes and surrounding woods long formed the setting for local fishing and hunting.
simp_chinese: 沙茨克位于柳齐梅尔湖北岸，周围是沃里尼亚西北部的森林、沼泽与湖群。它首见于1410年的记载：瓦迪斯瓦夫·雅盖沃国王在对条顿骑士团作战前，派猎人进入当地森林为军队筹措猎物。到1595年，沙茨克已被记为城镇。湖泊与林地长期是当地渔猎活动的场所。

english: Shatur is an old village in the forest and marsh country of Meshchera. It appears in the 1406 testament of Grand Prince Vasily Dmitriyevich, and by the end of the fifteenth century a district bore its name. The village stood among the scattered settlements and waterways of the region, where sandy ground and wetlands interrupted the woodland. Its parish church provided a centre for the surrounding rural community.
simp_chinese: 沙图尔是梅晓拉森林与沼泽地区的一座古村。它见于大公瓦西里·德米特里耶维奇1406年的遗嘱，15世纪末已有以它命名的乡区。村庄周围林地、沙地与湿地交错，水道和分散的聚落点缀其间。教区教堂是附近乡村社群的中心。

english: Shatyrlysay is a tributary of the Emba in the dry country west of the Mugodzhar Hills. Its valley belongs to a river system fed largely by snowmelt, with spring floods followed by a much drier summer. Water in the Emba valley is fresher in spring and grows saltier during the warm season. The surrounding steppe has low shrubs and many channels that carry water only seasonally.
simp_chinese: 沙特尔雷赛是穆戈扎尔丘陵以西干旱地区的一条恩巴河支流。这条河谷属于主要由融雪补给的水系，春季洪水之后是干燥得多的夏季。恩巴河谷的水在春季较淡，暖季则变咸。周围草原生长着低矮灌木，许多水道只有在特定季节才有水流。

english: Shavgar lies near Lake Akkol, north of the Karatau Mountains. The Assa River flows into Akkol after passing through Lake Bilikol farther south, then continues towards the sands of the Moyynkum. Akkol's water level changes with the Assa's flow and the seasons, leaving the lake and its shores within an open landscape of steppe and desert.
simp_chinese: 沙夫加尔位于阿科尔湖附近，在卡拉套山以北。阿萨河穿过南面的比利科尔湖后流入阿科尔，再继续流向莫因库姆沙地。阿科尔的水位随阿萨河流量和季节变化，湖泊及其岸边坐落在开阔的草原与荒漠之间。

english: Shawanaga is an Anishinaabe homeland on the eastern shore of Georgian Bay, a coast of rocky islands, sheltered waters and forest. Its name is understood in Ojibwe as Long Bay. The Shawanaga River flows west to the bay, while the people's traditional country extends from the Seguin River north to the Magnetawan and east towards the Ottawa valley. The shoreline and Shawanaga Island have been home to their ancestors for many generations.
simp_chinese: 沙瓦纳加是乔治亚湾东岸的阿尼希纳贝人故土，岸边遍布岩石岛屿、受庇护的水域和森林。其名称在奥吉布瓦语中被理解为“长湾”。沙瓦纳加河向西注入海湾；沙瓦纳加人的传统土地南起塞甘河，北至马格内塔万河，向东延伸至渥太华河谷。海岸与沙瓦纳加岛世代以来都是他们祖先的家园。

english:
Shawanoe recalls the Shawnee people, whose villages and hunting grounds extended into the Cumberland River country. Early French maps called the Cumberland the River of the Shawnees. By the 1670s Shawnee hunters and traders were active along its course, and French traders later established posts in the valley.

The Cumberland country was also claimed as a hunting ground by the Cherokee and used by the Chickasaw. Competition led to fighting, and in 1714 Cherokee and Chickasaw forces drove the Shawnee from the region. French influence in the valley was diminished as well. Shawnee communities moved to other parts of the Ohio and Mississippi valleys, carrying their relationships and trading connections with them. Some later settled among the Creeks farther south in Alabama.
simp_chinese:
沙瓦诺使人想起肖尼人，他们的村庄和猎场曾延伸至坎伯兰河地区。早期法国地图将坎伯兰河称为“肖尼人之河”。到十七世纪七十年代，肖尼猎人与商人已沿河活动，法国商人后来也在河谷建立贸易站。

切罗基人也将坎伯兰地区视为猎场，奇克索人同样在此活动。竞争引发战争，1714年切罗基人与奇克索人联合将肖尼人逐出这一地区，法国人在河谷的影响也随之减弱。肖尼社群迁往俄亥俄河和密西西比河谷的其他地方，继续维持他们的社会与贸易联系。一些人后来定居在更南面的阿拉巴马，与克里克人共同生活。

english: At Shawinigan the Saint-Maurice plunges over a rocky barrier in a great waterfall. Canoe travellers had to leave the river and carry their vessels over the ridge to pass it. The Atikamekw name Achawenekane recalls this portage over the crest, while an Abenaki name likewise refers to a sloping portage. In 1651 the Jesuit Jacques Buteux travelled up the Saint-Maurice to the falls; missionaries visiting the upper river later stopped here on their journeys.
simp_chinese: 圣莫里斯河在沙威尼根越过岩石屏障，形成一道大瀑布。乘独木舟旅行的人必须离开河道，扛着船翻过山脊才能绕行。阿蒂卡梅克语名称阿肖韦内卡内使人想起这条越过山脊的搬运路，阿贝纳基语名称同样指倾斜的转运路。1651年，耶稣会士雅克·比特沿圣莫里斯河而上抵达瀑布；后来前往上游的传教士也在此停留。

english:
Shawmut was the peninsula on Massachusetts Bay where the English established Boston. Originally a small tract joined to the mainland by a narrow neck, it had three prominent hills and a spring of fresh water. Boston's harbour opened the town to the Atlantic, helping it grow into the political and commercial centre of Puritan New England.

In 1630 William Blaxton invited Puritan settlers from Charlestown to the peninsula, where they founded Boston near the spring. A century and a half later, disputes over British taxation brought resistance to a head with the Boston Tea Party. War followed: colonial forces besieged the British in Boston, and the British evacuated in March 1776. In the early nineteenth century the town's hills and shoreline were reshaped as the growing settlement expanded into surrounding waters.
simp_chinese:
绍穆特是马萨诸塞湾畔的半岛，英国人在此建立了波士顿。它原是一小片土地，以狭长地峡连接大陆，岛上有三座显著的山丘和一处淡水泉。波士顿港通向大西洋，帮助城镇发展为清教徒新英格兰的政治与商业中心。

1630年，威廉·布莱克斯顿邀请查尔斯敦的清教徒移民来到半岛，他们在泉水附近建立波士顿。一个半世纪后，有关英国税收的争端在波士顿倾茶事件中达到高潮。战争随之爆发：殖民地军队围困城内英军，英军于1776年3月撤离。十九世纪初，城镇不断扩张，山丘与海岸线也因向水域填地而逐渐改变。

english: Cumberland Gap cuts through the long ridge of Cumberland Mountain, opening a way between the Powell and Cumberland river valleys. The basin to its west lies below the pass, surrounded by wooded heights. Indigenous peoples, including the Shawnee and Cherokee, used the gap for hunting, trade and settlement. In 1750 the explorer Thomas Walker passed through it, and a quarter of a century later Daniel Boone helped mark a road westward. Settlers followed, bringing conflict over Indigenous lands beyond the mountains.
simp_chinese: 坎伯兰隘口穿过坎伯兰山绵长的山脊，在鲍威尔河谷与坎伯兰河谷之间打开一条通道。隘口西面的盆地低于山道，四周环绕着林木覆盖的高地。肖尼人、切罗基人等原住民曾利用这处隘口狩猎、贸易和定居。1750年，探险者托马斯·沃克穿过这里；约二十五年后，丹尼尔·布恩参与标出了向西的道路。移民随后涌入，引发了山脉另一侧原住民土地上的冲突。

english:
Shaxi belongs to the Bozhou country of northern Guizhou, where mountain slopes and cultivated valleys supported communities with diverse local traditions. Farming used suitable ground, while livestock, woodland resources and crafts added to household production. Paths connected villages with markets and neighbouring basins, allowing salt, cloth and tools to circulate alongside agricultural and forest products. Terrain made route knowledge important to both travel and the practical exercise of authority.

Bozhou's Shaxi was fortified in 1382, early in the Ming. In the Ming campaign against Bozhou in 1600, a Shaxi southwest of Zunyi served as one of the routes into the territory, and An Jiangchen's troops from Shuixi advanced by it. The campaign ended the hereditary Yang rulers' authority, and Bozhou was reorganized under regular imperial administration.
simp_chinese:
沙溪属于贵州北部播州地区，山坡与耕作河谷支持地方传统多样的社区。农业利用适宜土地，牲畜、林地资源和手工业增加家庭生产。小径把村庄同市场及邻近盆地连接起来，让盐、布匹和工具同农产林产品一起流通。地形使道路知识对旅行及实际行使权威都十分重要。

洪武十五年（1382年），明初在播州修筑了沙溪城。明万历二十八年（1600年）平播之役中，遵义西南的沙溪是进入播州的通道之一，水西安疆臣的军队由此推进。这场战役结束了杨氏的世袭统治，播州随后改为朝廷直接管理的州县。

english: Shā County lies beside the Shā stream in the interior of Fújiàn. Under the Sòng, cultivation expanded and a bridge was built across the stream, joining its two banks. The county also produced scholars and officials, including the Confucian thinker Luó Cóngyàn. In 1448, during the Míng, Dèng Màoqī raised an uprising at Chénshānzhài.
simp_chinese: 沙县位于福建内陆的沙溪畔。宋代，耕地不断开拓，溪上首次架桥连接两岸。县中还涌现出理学家罗从彦等学者和官员。明正统十三年（1448年），邓茂七在陈山寨起事。

english: Shāyáng stands beside the Hàn River in central Húběi. Known in Hàn times as Hànjīn Ferry, it grew into a market and landing on the river. In 1376 the Míng abolished neighbouring Chánglín County and placed a patrol office at Shāyáng. The river continued to carry boats and goods through the town between the interior and the Yangtze.
simp_chinese: 沙洋位于湖北中部的汉江畔。汉代此处称汉津渡，后来发展为渡口集市和河港。明洪武九年（1376年），长林县并入荆门县，沙洋设巡检司。汉江继续承载船只货物往来内陆与长江之间。

english: Shayar lies south of the Kucha oasis, close to the Tarim River and the northern edge of the Taklamakan Desert. The river flows east across the basin, sustaining a narrow belt of vegetation amid the sands. Shayar's name appears in Qing records as a place in the northern Tarim country. Its fields and settlements belong to the riverine landscape between the mountain-fed oases and the great desert.
simp_chinese: 沙雅位于龟兹绿洲以南，靠近塔里木河和塔克拉玛干沙漠北缘。河水向东穿过盆地，在沙海间滋养出狭长的植被地带。清代文献已有沙雅尔地名的记载，其田地与聚落属于山水绿洲和大沙漠之间的河岸景观。

english: Near the entrance to the Persian Gulf, islands and headlands lie along the approaches to the Strait of Hormuz. On the Arabian shore, Julfar grew as a trading town connected to ports throughout the Indian Ocean. Its merchants handled pottery and other goods brought from distant lands, including China. The narrow waters and coastal anchorages made this a meeting place for ships moving between the gulf and the open sea.
simp_chinese: 波斯湾入口附近，岛屿与岬角分布于通往霍尔木兹海峡的航道上。阿拉伯岸边的朱尔法发展为贸易城镇，与印度洋各地港口相连。商人经手来自中国等遥远地区的陶器和其他货物。狭窄水道与沿海锚地成为船只往来海湾和开阔大海的会合处。

english:
Shazhou, the old name of Dunhuang, occupies an oasis at the western end of the Hexi Corridor. Here the roads across Central Asia converged before entering the long passage eastward through Gansu. Water from the Dang River sustained fields amid the desert, and merchants, pilgrims and envoys passed through the oasis. Southeast of the town, the Mogao Caves were cut into a long cliff above the Daquan River. Their painted walls and sculpted Buddhas bear witness to centuries of artistic exchange across Asia.

Under the Yuan, Shazhou became the seat of a circuit, but in 1292 inhabitants of Shazhou and Guazhou were moved eastward toward Ganzhou. The Ming later established Shazhou Garrison, whose people were moved east in the fifteenth century amid struggles over the frontier. As control of the lands beyond Jiayuguan changed hands, the old city declined. The caves, decorated and maintained over many dynasties through the Yuan, remained a record of the oasis's earlier wealth and religious life.

In the 1720s the Qing established a post and then a garrison at Shazhou, and a new walled settlement arose east of the old town. Settlers from elsewhere in Gansu cultivated the oasis and contributed to the repair of its Buddhist caves. In 1760 the garrison became Dunhuang County, reviving a name from the town's ancient past.
simp_chinese:
沙州是敦煌的旧称，坐落在河西走廊西端的一片绿洲上。穿越中亚的道路在此汇合，再向东进入甘肃狭长的走廊。党河水滋润沙漠中的农田，商人、僧侣与使节从绿洲经过。城东南大泉河边的长崖上开凿着莫高窟，洞窟中的壁画和彩塑见证了亚洲各地数百年的艺术交流。

元代沙州成为一路治所，但1292年沙州与瓜州居民被迁往东面的甘州一带。明朝后来设置沙州卫，十五世纪边地争斗之中，卫所部众又被迁往东边。嘉峪关外的控制权不断易手，故城逐渐衰落。历代直到元朝不断营建、修饰的石窟，仍保存着绿洲昔日富庶与宗教生活的痕迹。

十八世纪二十年代，清朝在沙州先设所、后设卫，并于故城以东另筑新城。来自甘肃其他地方的移民耕种绿洲，也参与修缮佛教石窟。1760年，沙州卫改为敦煌县，重用了这座城镇古老的名字。

english: Shcherbinovka lies in the Yeya country near the northeastern shore of the Sea of Azov. In 1794 the Shcherbinovsky kuren was among the Black Sea Cossack communities allotted land in the Kuban. Their arrival followed the annexation of the region by Russia and the establishment of posts and settlements along its frontier. Nearby fisheries, grasslands and the Yeya estuary formed the setting in which the Cossacks made new homes after moving from their earlier lands.
simp_chinese: 谢尔比诺夫卡位于叶亚河地区，靠近亚速海东北岸。1794年，谢尔比诺夫库连是黑海哥萨克在库班获得土地的社群之一。他们迁来之前，俄国已吞并这一地区，并在边疆设立哨所和聚落。附近的渔场、草原与叶亚河口湾构成哥萨克离开旧居地后建立新家园的环境。

english: The Shchuchya flows from Lake Bolshoye Shchuchye in the Polar Urals toward the lower Ob. In its upper course it rushes among rocky slopes; farther downstream it crosses low country and divides into channels and shallow floodplain lakes before joining the great river. Its Nenets name, Pyryakha, refers to pike, a fish found in these northern waters.
simp_chinese: 休奇亚河从极地乌拉尔的博尔肖耶休奇耶湖流出，向鄂毕河下游流去。上游河水奔过多岩山坡，往下游进入低地，在汇入大河之前分成水道与浅泛滥湖。涅涅茨语河名皮里亚哈与梭鱼有关，这种鱼生活在北方水域。

english: Shchuchye stands among the lakes of the southern Trans-Ural plain. The settlement takes its name from Lake Shchuchye, while the shore of Lake Nifanovskoye lies close by. A village was established here in the 1750s, in a district where Russian fortified settlements and villages had begun to appear in the late seventeenth century. Lakes remain a conspicuous feature of the surrounding country.
simp_chinese: 休奇耶坐落在南外乌拉尔平原的湖泊之间，聚落得名于休奇耶湖，尼法诺夫斯科耶湖岸也近在旁边。村庄建立于十八世纪五十年代；早在十七世纪末，这片地区已开始出现俄国堡寨和村落。众多湖泊是周围乡野的显著特征。

english: Shchuchye lies in the lake and forest country north of Smolensk, near the Mezha River and the upper Western Dvina basin. Its name, shared by a lake and the surrounding district, means a place associated with pike. The lake is among the largest in the Smolensk uplands, set amid woods and wetlands. This was a borderland of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania before the Smolensk lands passed to Russian control in the seventeenth century.
simp_chinese: 舒丘奇耶位于斯摩棱斯克以北的湖泊森林地带，靠近梅扎河和西德维纳河上游流域。湖泊与周边地区共用的名称与梭鱼有关。湖水是斯摩棱斯克高地面积最大的湖泊之一，四周环绕森林和湿地。这里曾是立陶宛大公国的边地，17世纪斯摩棱斯克诸地转归俄罗斯控制。

english:
Shchuchyn belongs to the Lida country of the historical Grand Duchy of Lithuania, where agricultural estates, villages and small market towns formed a connected rural landscape.
